view_frame: The drawing provides a TOP view in the XY plane. The X-axis represents width (40 mm), the Y-axis represents depth (30 mm), and the Z-axis represents height/thickness (12 mm). The origin (0,0) is at the bottom-left corner of the block.

features.evidence: Text 'Body: 40 wide x 30 deep x 12 thick' and the rectangular outline in the TOP view.

features.placement: Centred at (20, 15) in the XY plane. Extends through the full Z height (0 to 12).
features.evidence: Circular outline in the TOP view labelled 'Ø8' and text 'Opening centred in top face'. User clarification confirms it is a through-hole.

connections: The central_opening is subtracted from the block_body.
edit_rules: Changing the block width (X) or depth (Y) must maintain the opening's centred position relative to the new dimensions.
Changing the block thickness (Z) must maintain the through-hole nature of the opening.
Changing the opening diameter (Ø) must maintain its circular shape and centred position.
